title: Rivu local offline neural inference request v1

input_path.description: Existing local IEEE float32 WAV/WAVEX/RF64; 8000..192000Hz; nonempty <=4h. Speech mono/stereo; separation stereo only.

output_dir.description: Must not exist; existing parent. Worker owns only this newly created directory. Source is never modified. Results are published by complete event only. Caller terminates/reaps on cancellation and removes its task scratch.

model_manifest.description: Explicit node-local prepare.py manifest. Speech IDs: MossFormer2_SE_48K, nsnet2, DeepFilterNet3. Separation IDs: melband_roformer_kim, htdemucs. Exact dependency versions, SHA256 of every local artifact and factual weight-license/provenance records required; no license grant inferred. No global registry, implicit download, alternate model or device fallback.

wet_mix.description: Source-rate linear dry/wet blend. Zero preserves original samples bit-exactly.

attenuation_limit_db.description: Minimum spectral mask gain, not waveform clipping or level normalization.

post_filter.description: Only DeepFilterNet3 supports this parameter. Presence is rejected for MossFormer2 or NSNet2, including false.
